reels.title: M32 SPOTLIGHT EFFECT
reels.yt_title: The Spotlight Effect: why you think everyone is staring #Shorts
reels.caption:
The spotlight effect: why you think everyone is staring. 🔦

You spill coffee on your shirt and feel like the whole room noticed. In a Cornell study (Gilovich, 2000), people guessed 50% noticed their embarrassing shirt. Really? About 25%.

Everyone is busy with their own spotlight. So go do the thing.

Send this to someone who overthinks.

#psychology #spotlighteffect #overthinking #confidence #mindset

reels.title: M31 LATTE
reels.caption:
This coffee costs $172,000. ☕

$5 a day, every single morning. Invest it instead at 7% a year and after 30 years that's $172,391. Just saving it? $54,750.

It was never about the coffee. It's the small things you don't see.

Send this to your coffee friend.

#money #investing #personalfinance #compoundinterest #saving
